LanguageData.Gun_Arisaka_Type_99_Long_RWP.label: Arisaka Type 99 Long
LanguageData.Gun_Arisaka_Type_99_Long_RWP.description: The Arisaka Type 99 Long is a bolt-action rifle known for its durability and high accuracy over long distances. Developed during World War II, it features a powerful cartridge that can deliver significant damage to targets. While it has a slower firing rate compared to semi-automatic rifles, its precision and stopping power make it a reliable choice for marksmen who engage from a distance.
